Name: UPDATED Zen Garden all Obelisks for CONTENT PATCHER
Author: Pixibee
Description:
Hello again,

This mod makes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/742]Monteso's Zen Garden Obelisk Earth and Water[/url] mod compatible with content patcher, and also adds my desert and island obelisk. :)

__________________________
Main file:
This mod requires SMAPI and content patcher to work

How to download WITH content patcher: (recommended)
1. Install SMAPI
2. Install content patcher
3. Place the mod into the /Mods folder
4. Unzip the file
5. Enjoy!
__________________________
